Oysters natural.d: Opened to order, on crushed ice. Shallots in red wine vinegar, cracked pepper and lemon.
Oysters natural.note: Six for 6.50 at the raw bar.

Fish and chip cones.d: White fish in a cold lager batter, cooked golden. Thick-cut potatoes done twice for crunch. Tartar sauce and lemon, in a paper cone.
Fish and chip cones.note: Hold on to the cone at the rail.

Whole lobster.d: About 1¾ lb, split, brushed with garlic butter and finished under the broiler. Drawn butter, lemon, a cracker, a pick and a bib.

Ocean blue jelly cups.d: Sweet coconut cream set firm, a clear sea-colored layer poured over, gummy fish on top.
Ocean blue jelly cups.note: From the galley on every sailing.

Blue lagoon.d: Vodka and blue curaçao over ice, topped with lemon-lime soda and a lemon wheel.
